cases.translation: His foundation is on the holy mountains.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) with location requires the prepositional case горах.

cases.sentence: Господь любит врата Сиона, больше всех поселений ___.
cases.translation: The Lord loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
cases.explain: The genitive Иакова shows comparison: more than the dwellings of Jacob.

cases.translation: Glorious things are said of you, O city of God.
cases.explain: Город is the subject in nominative case after the verb возвещаются.

cases.sentence: Упомяну знающим меня Арааве и Вавилоне, вот филистимляне и Тир с ___.
cases.translation: I tell of Rahab and Babylon to those who acknowledge me—of Philistia and Tyre, along with Cush.
cases.explain: The word с (with) requires the instrumental case Кушем.

cases.sentence: А Сионе скажут, такой-то и такой-то родился в ___.
cases.translation: Of Zion it will be said, 'This one was born there.'
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) requires the prepositional case нем.

cases.sentence: Господь в переписи народов напишет, такой-то родился ___.
cases.translation: The Lord will write in the register of the peoples: 'This one was born there.'
cases.explain: Там (there) is an adverb indicating location.

cases.sentence: Все поющие и играющие скажут, все источники мои в ___.
cases.translation: All my springs are in you.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with prepositional requires тебе.

cases.translation: A psalm of the sons of Korah.
cases.explain: The genitive Караха shows possession: 'of Korah', used after the noun сыновей.

reading.question: Where is the foundation of God's city?
reading.explain: The psalm states 'Основание его на святых горах' (His foundation is on the holy mountains).

reading.ru: Господь любит врата Сиона, больше всех поселений Иакова.
reading.question: What does the Lord love more than other places?
options: The gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob
The dwellings of Jacob more than Zion
reading.correct: The gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob
reading.explain: The text clearly states 'Господь любит врата Сиона, больше всех поселений Иакова' (The Lord loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob).

reading.ru: А Сионе скажут, такой-то и такой-то родился в нем, и Всевышний сам укрепит его.
reading.question: What will be said about Zion?
options: Men and women were born there, and the Most High Himself will establish it
No one will be born there
It will be destroyed and forgotten
Only the wicked will dwell there
reading.correct: Men and women were born there, and the Most High Himself will establish it
reading.explain: The psalm states 'А Сионе скажут, такой-то и такой-то родился в нем, и Всевышний сам укрепит его' (Of Zion it will be said, 'This one and that one were born in her,' and the Most High Himself will establish her).

reading.ru: Господь в переписи народов напишет, такой-то родился там.
reading.question: What does the Lord record in the register of peoples?
options: That this one was born there
Names of those who reject Him
reading.correct: That this one was born there
reading.explain: The text states 'Господь в переписи народов напишет, такой-то родился там' (The Lord will write in the register of the peoples: 'This one was born there').

reading.ru: Славные возвещаются о тебе, город Божий.
reading.question: What is said about God's city?
options: Glorious things are spoken of you, O city of God
Nothing is said about this city
reading.correct: Glorious things are spoken of you, O city of God
reading.explain: The psalm declares 'Славные возвещаются о тебе, город Божий' (Glorious things are said of you, city of God).

reading.ru: Все поющие и играющие скажут, все источники мои в тебе.
reading.question: What do the singers and musicians declare about their sources?
options: All their springs are in Zion
Their springs are in distant lands
They have no sources of blessing
Only enemies dwell in their springs
reading.correct: All their springs are in Zion
reading.explain: Those who sing and play declare 'все источники мои в тебе' (All my springs are in you [Zion]).
